description: This file implements the SerialWorker class for handling asynchronous work with retry and backoff logic, including managing work items, scheduling retries, and handling state transitions.

classes.name: SerialWorker
classes.description: A class that manages asynchronous work items with retry logic, exponential backoff, and state management.

classes.name: SerialWorker::WorkItem
classes.description: A nested class representing a unit of work to be processed by SerialWorker.

methods.name: SerialWorker::WorkItem::FollowupWork
methods.description: Executes a callback after work is completed.

methods.name: SerialWorker::SerialWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker with retry limits and backoff policy.

methods.name: SerialWorker::WorkNow
methods.description: Triggers immediate work execution, resetting backoff and canceling retries.

methods.name: SerialWorker::WorkNowInternal
methods.description: Handles the internal logic to start work based on current state.

methods.name: SerialWorker::Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing work and prevents further processing.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnDoWorkFinished
methods.description: Callback invoked when a work item completes, managing subsequent steps based on state.

methods.name: SerialWorker::OnFollowupWorkFinished
methods.description: Handles completion of follow-up work, managing retries and backoff.

methods.name: SerialWorker::RerunWork
methods.description: Re-initiates work if retriggered during processing.

methods.name: SerialWorker::GetBackoffEntryForTesting
methods.description: Returns the backoff entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: SerialWorker::GetRetryTimerForTesting
methods.description: Returns the retry timer for testing purposes.

methods.name: SerialWorker::AsWeakPtr
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the SerialWorker instance.
